title: Roasted Mushroom and Golden Potato Gratin
description: A rich and flavorful gratin made with roasted mushrooms and golden potatoes, perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the sliced potatoes with 1 tablespoon of butter, salt, and pepper until they are evenly coated.
Transfer the potatoes to a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
While the potatoes are roasting, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they are tender and lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Remove the potatoes from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
In a large baking dish, arrange a layer of potatoes, followed by a layer of mushrooms.
Repeat this process until all of the ingredients are used up, finishing with a layer of potatoes on top.
Sprinkle the shredded gratin over the top of the potatoes and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the gratin is golden brown and the potatoes are crispy.
Remove the gratin from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
